summary: Cheniere Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to report that its subsidiary, Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P., closed a private placement of $1 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.350% Senior Notes due 2036 and $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2056. The notes were issued under a base indenture and supplemental indentures with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. The securities are senior unsecured obligations of Cheniere Partners, guaranteed by certain subsidiaries, and were sold in reliance on Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
